title: Associations of Environmental, Waterway-Context, and Human-Activity Predictors with Blackchin Tilapia Records in Thailand
description: Versioned code, model-ready inputs permitted for redistribution, archived out-of-fold predictions, spatial diagnostics, and figures for an exploratory presence-background analysis of blackchin tilapia records in Thailand. Version 1.2.0 adds the analyses requested during peer review (Tables S3-S10 of the revised article): record-level provenance of the 38 records, rank stability of predictor importance, a leave-one-repetition-out check of configuration selection, comparisons of pseudo-absence strategies, a 12-setting sensitivity analysis of the uncertainty-zone rule, a residual correlogram, and a sensitivity analysis adding 14 grid cells omitted by the order of record processing. The unpublished manuscript is not included. Screening surfaces are not occurrence probabilities or operational risk maps.
